basis: Pathogen-defined infection umbrella with variable sites; respiratory damage is not established in most patients across the group.

decisions.pulmonary: none: pneumonia and sinusitis are site-specific presentations; their combined frequency across this umbrella is not established.

basis: Immune-mediated cardiac granulomas define disease; pulmonary granulomatous involvement accompanies cardiac sarcoidosis in roughly 50-80%.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary sarcoidosis accompanies cardiac disease in roughly 50-80% and represents the same systemic granulomatous process.

basis: Lissencephaly defines disease. Clinodactyly in 10/24 is minor dysmorphism without established dysfunction; specific cardiac malformations occur in 6/27 despite a broader frequent annotation.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: clinodactyly in 10/24 does not establish functional skeletal damage; hand contractures occur in 6/27, below 30%.

basis: B-cell developmental immunodeficiency with reduced B-cell counts and agammaglobulinemia in 4/4; recurrent otitis is a separate infection.

decisions.haematologic: primary: defective B-cell development with reduced B-cell counts in 4/4 is a disease of blood cells as well as an immunodeficiency.

basis: PLEVA causes cytotoxic T-cell-mediated epidermal injury and papulonecrotic skin lesions; systemic injury is mainly confined to the rare ulceronecrotic subtype.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: immune-mediated epidermal injury by cytotoxic T cells supports this mechanism axis despite uncertainty about the initiating trigger.

basis: Neurodevelopmental syndrome; HPO reports eyelid ptosis/blepharophimosis and urethral hypospadias at 80-99%. Recurrent infections alone do not establish immunodeficiency.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias is a structural urethral defect, within the renal axis, reported as very frequent (80-99%).
decisions.infectious_immune: none: recurrent infections in 9/12 establish susceptibility, but do not independently establish intrinsic immunodeficiency or immune-mediated disease.

basis: Inherited lipid biosynthesis disorder umbrella; neurologic damage is prominent in several subtypes, but its frequency across patients in the whole group is unestablished.

decisions.neurologic: none: neurologic injury varies by subtype; the supplied evidence does not establish that it affects most patients across this umbrella.

basis: Mitochondrial disease spectrum explicitly defined by optic atrophy and/or spastic ataxia; ocular and neurologic disease are its two defining presentations.

decisions.neurologic: primary: spastic ataxia is an explicitly defining presentation of the spectrum, rather than a secondary complication.
decisions.ocular: primary: optic atrophy is an explicitly defining presentation of the spectrum, rather than an incidental ocular finding.

basis: Osteolysis and lipoatrophy define disease. HPO reports RBBB in 2/2 and mitral regurgitation/atrial enlargement in 1/2, conflicting with the definition's absence of cardiac impairment.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: conduction abnormalities in 2/2 plus mitral regurgitation and chamber enlargement in 1/2 support cardiac involvement; the conflicting definition limits confidence.

basis: Laryngomalacia and cleft palate each 2/2; skeletal contractures/deformities 1/1 assessed. Tiny samples limit confidence; neurologic and ear findings omitted under the four-axis cap.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: laryngomalacia directly compromises the laryngeal airway and is reported in 2/2 assessed patients; the small denominator limits confidence.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: submucous cleft palate is a structural oral defect reported in 2/2 assessed patients; the small denominator limits confidence.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: joint contractures restrict movement, with additional skeletal malformations; reported findings are 1/1 assessed, so frequency estimates remain uncertain.
